caption: The drawing features three rectangular swatches of fabric, each with different arrangements of pleats and ruffles. Rendered in shades of graphite on an off-white or cream background, the largest swatch is positioned in the upper left quadrant and consists of several horizontal bands, alternating between closely gathered pleats and looser ruffles, culminating in a prominent ruffled edge at the bottom. The top right swatch, slightly smaller, is comprised of two horizontal ruffled bands near its center, separated by smoother fabric sections, with a faintly scalloped lower edge. The bottom left swatch displays two horizontal ruffles separated by narrow textured bands, with both ruffled edges protruding and overlapping, and a faint border along the bottom edge. The three fabric samples are spaced apart from one another, with significant empty space surrounding them, and the word "Ruchings" is inscribed in small text to the right of the lower two samples. The entire composition is minimalist and relies on detailed line work and subtle shading to depict the texture and form of the fabric samples.
